title: 第254章 钱思雨的妙计第253章 给我一个亿
content_zh:
第254章钱思雨的妙计
“我担心什么，没有了他，我就是家族未来的家主了，我偷着乐呢。”钱思雨笑嘻嘻的说道。
“死丫头你要气死我是不是！”钱万贯怒道。
赵建国赶忙劝道：“好了好了，钱老兄你就别跟这个丫头片子斤斤计较了。你现在就给沈良打电话，把沈良约过来谈一谈。”
“这个电话还是你来打吧，赵老弟，你是警务司的司长，你给沈署长打电话比我给他打电话更好使。”钱万贯说道。
赵建国想了想觉得是这个道理，于是就掏出自己的手机给沈良打电话。
而钱思雨已经叫来服务员，将刚刚赵富贵动过的那几盘菜撤走，并点了新的菜。
不多时，沈良就来了。
沈良来了之后，钱万贯和赵建国就一起劝说。
但他们两个人使出浑身解数，也没能让沈良松口。
“钱家主，赵司长，不是我不给你们面子，而是因为我现在也没有办法。如果钱博中得罪的是别人，倒也罢了。可他偏偏得罪了赵大爷，那我就真的无计可施了。”沈良说道。
赵建国恼火的说道：“沈良，你不要把锅往赵富贵的头上甩，那个赵富贵只不过是杏花村的一个老农而已，算得了什么？”
沈良摇摇头说道：“赵大爷可不是一般人，虽然他看起来好像普普通通甚至土里土气的，就像是一个面朝黄土背朝天的乡下老汉，但他的能量可大了。”
“他的医术，在我们桃花县无人能及，就连县城中心医院的院长都比不过他，甚至还好几次请他去县城医院提供医疗援助。”
“我说的这些都是真的，可不是夸大其词，钱家主赵司长，你们要是不相信的话就自己去打听打听，赵大爷现在在我们桃花县几乎可以说是无人不知无人不晓，当之无愧的神医！”
赵建国冷笑道：“说来说去，不就是一个治病疗伤的大夫么？他医术就是再好，又有什么用？”
沈良说道：“赵大爷治好了他们村村长的心脏病。”
“然后呢？你说这个是想表达什么？你不觉得这很好笑吗？他治好一个农村村长的心脏病，这种鸡毛蒜皮的破事也好意思拿出来说？”赵建国戏谑的说道，满脸都是讥讽之色。
沈良又说道：“他们村的村长叫苏玉洁，苏玉洁就是我们桃花县有史以来的第一位女县首苏淑珍的独生女。”
沈良此话一出，赵建国脸上的冷笑一下子凝固了！

就连钱万贯也露出了不可思议的表情。
沈良接着说道：“所以现在你们明白了吧，赵大爷的人脉雄厚的不得了，只要他愿意，他就能够把我们桃花县的县首叫过来。”
“所以钱博中的案子，我帮不了你们，我如果真的听你们的话，把钱博中给放了，赵大爷立马就能把苏县首搬出来压我，那到时候我该怎么办？你们二位能替我扛住这个大雷吗？”
“赵司长，虽然你是兰花市的警务司司长，比苏县首高半级，但是在桃花县，你还真拿人家没办法，毕竟这里就是人家的地盘，也是人家的主场。一旦苏县首给我穿小鞋，你根本帮不了我，所以我不能听你的，请你见谅。”
第254章钱思雨的妙计
content_en:
Chapter 254 Qian Siyu’s clever plan
"What am I worried about? Without him, I will be the future head of the family. I am secretly happy." Qian Siyu said with a smile.
"Damn girl, are you going to piss me off to death?" Qian Wagguan said angrily.
Zhao Jianguo hurriedly advised: "Okay, okay, brother Qian, stop fussing with this girl. You call Shen Liang now and invite Shen Liang over for a talk."
"You should make this call, brother Zhao. You are the director of the Police Department. It is better for you to call Director Shen than for me to call him." Qian Wanguan said.
Zhao Jianguo thought about it and felt that this was the truth, so he took out his mobile phone and called Shen Liang.
Qian Siyu had already called the waiter to remove the dishes that Zhao Fugui had just touched and ordered new dishes.
Not long after, Shen Liang came.
After Shen Liang arrived, Qian Wagguan and Zhao Jianguo persuaded him together.
But the two of them tried their best, but they couldn't make Shen Liang relent.
"Master Qian, Director Zhao, it's not that I don't give you face, but it's because I have nothing to do now. If Qian Bozhong offends someone else, that's fine. But he offended Uncle Zhao, then I really have nothing to do." Shen Liang said.
Zhao Jianguo said angrily: "Shen Liang, don't throw the blame on Zhao Fugui's head. That Zhao Fugui is just an old farmer in Xinghua Village. What does it matter?"
Shen Liang shook his head and said: "Uncle Zhao is not an ordinary person. Although he looks ordinary and even rustic, like an old country man with his face turned to the loess and his back to the sky, he has great energy."
"His medical skills are unmatched by anyone in our Taohua County. Even the director of the county central hospital cannot compare with him. He has even been asked to go to the county hospital several times to provide medical assistance."
"What I said is true, and I am not exaggerating. Director Zhao, the head of the Qian family, if you don't believe it, go and find out for yourself. Uncle Zhao is now known to almost everyone in our Taohua County, and he is a well-deserved miracle doctor!"
Zhao Jianguo sneered: "After all, isn't he just a doctor who treats diseases and injuries? No matter how good his medical skills are, what's the use?"
Shen Liang said: "Uncle Zhao cured the heart disease of their village chief."
"Then what? What do you want to express by saying this? Don't you think it's funny? He cured a rural village chief's heart disease. How dare he mention such a trivial thing?" Zhao Jianguo said jokingly, with a look of sarcasm on his face.
Shen Liang added: "The head of their village is called Su Yujie. Su Yujie is the only daughter of Su Shuzhen, the first female county chief in the history of our Taohua County."
As soon as Shen Liang said these words, the sneer on Zhao Jianguo's face suddenly froze!
Even Qian Waguan showed an incredible expression.
Shen Liang continued: "So now you understand, Uncle Zhao has extremely strong connections. As long as he is willing, he can call the head of our Taohua County over."
"So I can't help you with Qian Bozhong's case. If I really listen to you and let Qian Bozhong go, Uncle Zhao will immediately move the head of Su County out to suppress me. So what should I do then? Can you two handle this big thunder for me?"
"Director Zhao, although you are the director of the police department of Lanhua City, half a rank higher than the head of Su County, you really can't do anything to others in Taohua County. After all, this is their territory and their home court. Once the head of Su County puts on my shoes, you can't help me at all, so I can't listen to you. Please forgive me."
Chapter 254 Qian Siyu’s clever plan
